name: TC-06-maintenance-request
description: TC-06.1: Maintenance Request Standard Approval Flow — Draft → Pending Approval → Approved → Release → Completed

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — Maintenance Request List
doc_metadata.caption: Navigate to Maintenance Request. Maintenance requests are used to report issues, request corrective maintenance, or schedule preventive maintenance tasks.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Opening screenshot for the Maintenance Request chapter.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — New Maintenance Request
doc_metadata.caption: Click 'Add New' to create a new maintenance request. Fill in the requestor, asset, priority, category, and description fields.

steps.value: E2E Test — Motor vibration excessive, requires corrective maintenance

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — Fill Description
doc_metadata.caption: Enter "E2E Test — Motor vibration excessive, re" into the Description field.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — MR Created (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request is created with an auto-generated ID (e.g., MTREQ-00001) and workflow state 'Draft'. From here you can submit it for approval.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the auto-generated ID and Draft state badge.

doc_metadata.title: TC-06.1 — Maintenance Request Detail (Draft)
doc_metadata.caption: The maintenance request is in Draft state. The workflow dropdown shows available transitions. Click 'Submit for Approval' to advance the request.
doc_metadata.manual_hint: Show the workflow dropdown with available transitions.
